parts.name: Stanchion Pipe Mounts - Tee Mount
parts.description: Steel tee pipe mount that attaches 28mm Flexpipe piping to 80/20 T-slot profiles. It can be used in horizontal or vertical orientation to mount to flat surfaces, with a self drilling screw securing the pipe.
features: Use self drilling screw to secure pipe
Use in horizontal or vertical orientation to mount to flat surfaces
parts.notes: Series badges printed: 15, 30, 40, 45 and P (Flexpipe). Mount to T-Slot hardware for 15 series: Washer PN column shows "--" with Qty. 2 (no washer part number given). Secure to pipe with 1 x F-A858 Self Drilling Screw (sold in box of 100), listed as P-series hardware.

page_notes.867: Pipe & Joint (Flexpipe) page 13-38: Stanchion Pipe Mounts AF-TSM / AF-CSM (badged 15/30/40/45/P) extracted; Stanchion Mounts AF-OTM / AF-OSM are P-only and skipped; metric-only (30/45) suggested hardware rows and P-only screw F-A858 not attached as 15/F hardware.

remaining_doubts: Mount to T-Slot hardware row for 15/40 series shows Washer PN '--' with Qty. 2; no washer part number is printed, so no washer entry was attached (recorded in notes).
F-A858 Self Drilling Screw (Secure to Pipe) is badged P only, so it is mentioned in notes but not attached as 15/F suggested_hardware.
